text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain deferred P3; not obsolete/completed. Current scalafim.locus.Aggregation.foldMapBy still owns a mutable accumulation loop, checks ambient identity, skips undefined parcel mappings and returns IndexedField. build.sbt still declares locusData cats-kernel and other modules independently use Cats. Any migration must qualify adopted locus4s aggregation semantics before removing this loop; remove only the retired module dependency, not Cats across the repository. No present correctness/performance defect was demonstrated by this source assessment, so provider cleanup remains behind core work.
